records.text: Pete Hegseth was photographed in Washington, D.C., at 3 p.m. on September 9 greeting Singapore's defense minister.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I checked Pete Hegseth's schedule on September 9th. He was in Washington, D.C. at 3 p.m. greeting Singapore's Minister of Defense. ... He's photographed.

verification.notes: Official DVIDS photographs place Hegseth with Singapore Defense Minister Chan Chun Sing at the Pentagon on September 9, 2025. Contemporaneous schedule reporting places the bilateral event at 3 p.m. Eastern.
